Paper_Metadata.Paper_Title: GPUMD 4.0: A high-performance molecular dynamics package for versatile materials simulations with machine-learned potentials

Composition_Info.Note: Computational tool supporting NEP, EAM, Tersoff, etc.

Process_Text.original: GPUMD incorporates native machine-learned potentials (NEP) and is optimized for GPU computing.
Process_Text.simplified: 基于GPU优化的分子动力学软件，集成原生机器学习势(NEP)。

Properties_Info.Note: GPUMD offers about two orders of magnitude speedup compared to CPU-based codes.

Composition_Info.Note: Referenced from study on lithium nonstoichiometry.

Process_Text.original: Exploration of lithium nonstoichiometry effects on ionic conductivity using NEP model.
Process_Text.simplified: 使用NEP模型探索锂非化学计量比对离子电导率的影响。

Process_Text.original: Thermal conductivity calculation of Cu using NEP potential within GPUMD.
Process_Text.simplified: 在GPUMD中使用NEP势函数计算金属铜的热导率。

Properties_Info.Note: Representative value consistent with experimental data.
